# Preply

> > Preply is a global online tutoring marketplace connecting language learners with private tutors for personalized lessons in English, Spanish, Korean, and dozens of other languages.

The platform features tens of thousands of certified tutors offering one-on-one lessons for learners worldwide, with specialized options for business English, test preparation (TEFL), and conversational fluency. Preply serves students across the United States, Canada, UK, Spain, Mexico, and many other countries.

## Key Topics

- Online tutoring marketplace
- Private language lessons
- English tutors and teachers
- Language learning strategies
- Speaking confidence techniques
- Fast language learning methods
- Business English instruction
- TEFL certification
- Polyglot advice (Olly Richards)
- Progress strategies for learners
- Teacher marketplace platform
- Location-based tutoring services
- Conversational fluency development
- Personalized learning approaches
